description: Statistics Mauritius ran its 2022 Housing Census between April and June 2022 and publishes Volume I, Housing and Living Conditions, as an Excel workbook of 31 tables by district, municipal ward and village council area, with Rodrigues regions. Building tables cover type, storeys, wall and roof materials and year of completion. Housing unit tables cover water supply, domestic water tanks, electricity, toilets and refuse disposal, and household tables cover cooking and water heating fuels, appliances, internet and vehicles. Special tables count residential buildings ever affected by severe flooding, 17,886 of 297,790 nationally, and buildings next to a river or canal by distance in metres. Another table counts housing units with electricity from the CEB grid, from photovoltaic panels or from other sources. Coverage is national, including Rodrigues. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration; later volumes cover demography, migration, disability, households, education and economic activity. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the site is a SharePoint portal that needs scripts for some pages, but the files download directly. Simulation uses: flood history and river proximity of buildings by ward for flood exposure models, and rooftop solar and water tanks for utility resilience. Related records: the Mauritius health statistics report.

schema_summary: Sheets HBD01 to HBD04: buildings by type, residential buildings by storeys, by wall and roof materials and year of completion. HDU01 to HDU11: housing units by units per building, ownership and mortgage, occupancy and vacancy, water supply, domestic water tank, electricity, toilets, bathing, kitchen, refuse disposal, rooms. HHH01 to HHH08: households by type, tenure and rent, crowding, cooking fuel, water heating fuel, appliances. HM01 to HM08: buildings ever affected by severe flooding, buildings next to a river or canal by distance in metres, electricity through CEB, photovoltaic and other sources, amenities, internet, vehicles and parking. Appendices: ward and village codes.
